question: How do they split text to obtain sentence levels?
Do they experiment with their proposed model on any other dataset other than MovieQA?

evidence: We also applied our model to MCTest dataset which requires machines to answer multiple-choice reading comprehension questions about fictional stories. The original paper describes that a baseline method uses a combination of a sliding window score and a distance based . They achieve 66.7% and 56.7% on MC500 and MC160 separately. Because of the restricted training set and development set, we trained our model on MovieQA training set and applied the result to test MCTest dataset. On MCTest dataset, we still outperform baseline and achieve 68.1% accuracy on MC160 and 61.5% accuracy on MC500.
